name: Paricalcitol
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: High-dose calcium products, other vitamin D compounds, thiazide diuretics
key_interactions.action: Monitor calcium more often; adjust the paricalcitol dose.

key_interactions.effect: Hypercalcemia raises the risk of digitalis toxicity (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor for digitalis toxicity and check calcium more often.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Strong CYP3A inhibitors (clarithromycin, itraconazole, ketoconazole, posaconazole, voriconazole, ritonavir, nelfinavir); grapefruit juice
key_interactions.action: A dose change may be needed when starting or stopping them; monitor intact PTH and calcium closely.
